mcqs.question: Under the Deep Ocean Mission, the Matsya-6000 submersible is designed to carry out human dives to what depth?
mcqs.explanation: Matsya-6000 is designed for human dives to 6,000 metres under the Deep Ocean Mission. The 500-metre figure refers to its first trials, while 12 hours and 96 hours refer to normal and emergency endurance, respectively.
